newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dassault Falcon 50EX gets FAA certificate.
newsitem.headline: Dassault Falcon 50EX gets FAA certificate.

text.p: France's Dassault Aviation said on Thursday that its Falcon 50EX business trijet had been certified by the U.S. Federal Aviation Agency (FAA).
Dassault said in a statement that the aircraft, the successor to the Falcon 50, got its FAA certification on December 20. Customer deliveries are due to start this month.
The Falcon 50EX was certified by the French civil aviation authority, the DGAC, on November 15, 1996.
The new aircraft relies on the same airframe and basic systems design as the Falcon 50, but features more powerful engines and climbs faster and travels farther.
